panels.title: Timers Over Time (use 'GroupBy filter to pick grouping)

targets.rawSql:
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT ${groupBy}
  FROM ${mpulse}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageDomainName in (${pageDomainName:sqlstring}) , ${pageDomainName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageGroupName in (${pageGroupName:sqlstring}),${pageGroupName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(deviceTypeName in (${deviceTypeName:sqlstring}),${deviceTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(beaconTypeName in (${beaconTypeName:sqlstring}),${beaconTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(isp in (${isp:sqlstring}),${isp} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(countryCode in (${countryCode:sqlstring}),${countryCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(regionCode in (${regionCode:sqlstring}),${regionCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(geoCity in (${geoCity:sqlstring}),${geoCity} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(paramsU in (${paramsU:sqlstring}),${paramsU} )
  and if (empty('${paramsULike}'),true, paramsU like '${paramsULike}')
  ${omniFilter}
  GROUP BY ${groupBy}
  ORDER BY count(*) DESC
  LIMIT ${topN}
)
SELECT ${groupBy} , 
  count(*) as "-", 
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) as time
FROM ${mpulse}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND ${groupBy} IN (SELECT ${groupBy} FROM top10)
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageDomainName in (${pageDomainName:sqlstring}) , ${pageDomainName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageGroupName in (${pageGroupName:sqlstring}),${pageGroupName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(deviceTypeName in (${deviceTypeName:sqlstring}),${deviceTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(beaconTypeName in (${beaconTypeName:sqlstring}),${beaconTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(isp in (${isp:sqlstring}),${isp} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(countryCode in (${countryCode:sqlstring}),${countryCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(regionCode in (${regionCode:sqlstring}),${regionCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(geoCity in (${geoCity:sqlstring}),${geoCity} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(paramsU in (${paramsU:sqlstring}),${paramsU} )
  and if (empty('${paramsULike}'),true, paramsU like '${paramsULike}')
  ${omniFilter}
GROUP BY 3, 1
ORDER BY 3
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Page Views per ${groupBy}; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
  coalesce(pageDomainName,'(None)') as item, 
  count(*) as count,
  ${aggregation}(${resourceType}${metric}) as metric
FROM ${mpulse}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageDomainName in (${pageDomainName:sqlstring}) , ${pageDomainName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(pageGroupName in (${pageGroupName:sqlstring}),${pageGroupName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(deviceTypeName in (${deviceTypeName:sqlstring}),${deviceTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(beaconTypeName in (${beaconTypeName:sqlstring}),${beaconTypeName} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(isp in (${isp:sqlstring}),${isp} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(countryCode in (${countryCode:sqlstring}),${countryCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(regionCode in (${regionCode:sqlstring}),${regionCode} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(geoCity in (${geoCity:sqlstring}),${geoCity} )
  AND $__conditionalAll(paramsU in (${paramsU:sqlstring}),${paramsU} )
  and if (empty('${paramsULike}'),true, paramsU like '${paramsULike}')
  ${omniFilter}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC 
LIMIT ${maxTreemapCells}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=${metric} by Hostname( ${aggregation}) ; du=${__user.login}'
